description: Check whether still images of a project show the SAME character as its character sheet — before paid clips are made from them. Each image is compared against the sheet's detail and fullbody views. It judges identity (species, build, colouring, head shape, large markings), NOT style, light, pose, place or props — and deliberately NOT micro details like an ear notch or the number of fingers, which no image model holds reliably. Free. Runs in the BACKGROUND: returns a `job_id` with HTTP 202 — poll it with lab_get_job until status is done|failed; the result lists per image passt, sicherheit, abweichungen, begruendung (or error). Up to 16 images and frames together per call. Images must be completed images of this project (imported images are refused). To check frames of a GENERATED CLIP (an orbit turnaround, a lab_animate clip) pass clip_frames: the clip's video_id and the seconds to cut out — the frames are taken from the clip itself and compared the same way; a second beyond the clip's end fails only that frame. The sheet needs a reference image (lab_generate_character_reference).

character_id.description: Character sheet id the images should show — positive integer as string

clip_frames.description: Frames cut out of generated clips; images and frames together at most 16.

sekunden.description: Seconds into the clip to cut a frame at, no duplicates (lab_bilder shows what is there)

video_id.description: Generated-video id of a clip in this project (from lab_orbit, lab_animate or lab_job_status) — positive integer as string; one entry per clip

image_ids.description: Completed image ids of this project (from lab_generate/lab_auto_storyboard) — positive integer strings, no duplicates. Give this and/or clip_frames.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string

name: lab_identitaet_pruefen
title: Identity Check
